title: Avatar Strength Assessment Protocol
description: Machine-readable interchange format for the Avatar Strength Assessment Protocol (v0.2). An assessment maps ten bounded-choice inputs about one avatar deployment to exactly one strength band, one dominant weakness class, and a deterministic remediation set. Normative text: AVATAR_STRENGTH_ASSESSMENT_PROTOCOL.md and STRONG_AVATAR_STANDARD.md. Reference implementation: spec/reference_implementation.py. Two conforming implementations given the same input MUST produce the same strength_band, dominant_weakness_class, active/partial weakness classes, ranked_remediating_components, and band_elevation_path.
$comment: Version 0.2.0. Identifiers W-01..W-10 and C-01..C-08 are permanent once assigned (AVATAR_INTEGRITY_ONTOLOGY.md versioning rules). Band criteria may not be relaxed to accommodate common practice.

inputValue.description: Bounded-choice response: Y = criterion fully met, P = partially met, N = not met. No free text is scored.

assessmentInput.description: The bounded questionnaire for one avatar deployment in one deployment context. Multi-context assessments require one protocol run per context.

A1.description: Consent Documentation: does a documented consent basis exist for the use of this likeness?

A2.description: Consent Scope: does the consent basis specify permitted use contexts, platforms, and duration?

A3.description: Revocation Mechanism: is there a documented process for the subject or rights holder to withdraw consent and remove the avatar from deployment?

B1.description: Origin Documentation: is the origin of this avatar (capture, generation, or training source) documented and traceable?

B2.description: Content Credentials: are content credentials or provenance metadata attached to the avatar in a tamper-evident form?

C1.description: Synthetic Disclosure: is the synthetic nature of this avatar disclosed in contexts where a viewer would reasonably need to know?

D1.description: Usage Scope Binding: are the avatar's authorized behaviors, roles, and statements documented and bounded?

D2.description: Accountable Owner: is there a named, contactable accountable party bound to this avatar's governance and behavior?

E1.description: Rights Chain: is the chain of title for the likeness or identity clear, current, and complete?

E2.description: Anti-Impersonation Controls: are there technical or procedural barriers that prevent this avatar from being cloned or repurposed for impersonation?

weaknessClass.description: Observable failure modes of a synthetic avatar or digital likeness deployment. W-01 Consent Absence, W-02 Provenance Void, W-03 Disclosure Failure, W-04 Identity Drift, W-05 Impersonation Exposure, W-06 Rights Ambiguity, W-07 Revocation Gap, W-08 Context Collapse, W-09 Attribution Loss, W-10 Robustness Weakness.

governanceComponent.description: Structural mechanisms that eliminate or reduce weakness classes. C-01 Consent Infrastructure, C-02 Provenance and Content Credentials Layer, C-03 Disclosure Layer, C-04 Scope and Usage Binding, C-05 Anti-Impersonation Controls, C-06 Rights Chain Documentation, C-07 Revocation and Kill-Switch Mechanism, C-08 Attribution and Accountable-Owner Binding.

strengthBand.description: The four strength bands of the Strong Avatar Standard, ordered weakest to strongest. Band determination is total: every input combination resolves to exactly one band.

referenceRoute.description: A registered reference route on strongavatar.com. Output link rule: an output element that points nowhere is a protocol violation.

assessmentOutput.description: The complete protocol output. Contains no numeric score, no subjective commentary on realism or aesthetics, and no recommendation outside the C-01..C-08 set.

protocol_version.description: Version of the protocol rule table used to produce this output.

dominant_weakness_class.description: Highest-severity active class using the priority order W-01 > W-02 > W-03 > W-04 > W-07 > W-08 > W-09 > W-05 > W-06 > W-10; if no class is active, the highest-severity partial class; null only when every class is inactive (Sovereign).

active_weakness_classes.description: All fully active weakness classes, in identifier order.

partial_weakness_classes.description: All partially active weakness classes, in identifier order.

ranked_remediating_components.description: Primary remediating components: components for active classes first in severity-priority order, then components for partial classes, deduplicated.

band_elevation_path.description: Minimum set of components whose full implementation raises the band by at least one level. Ties resolve to the smallest set, then lexicographic component order. Empty only for Sovereign.

references.description: Registered reference routes for every output element.
